en_how: Hard cuts every 1.2 s, each preceded by one pure white frame; every screen is a single-colour sunburst (charcoal, gold, alarm red, electric blue), thick-outlined comic lettering with hard shadows slams from oversized to full size, a round sponge mascot goes from squashed and sweating to bouncing with star eyes, and the selling-point ticker at the bottom scrolls with t throughout.
